name: Briarfin Thickets
introDiscord:
Thorned kelp knots together into a dense thicket ahead. Briarfin
Prowlers slip between the barbs without touching a single one, which
feels increasingly insulting the more branches catch on you.
introTwitch:
Thorned kelp knots together into a dense thicket ahead. Briarfin
Prowlers slip between the barbs without touching a single one, which
feels increasingly insulting the more branches catch on you.

briarfin-thickets-approach.prompt:
Three thorn-lined routes squeeze between braided briars. Loose straps
and dignity are equally endangered.

left.message:
A Briarfin Prowler slips through the thorns without making a sound.

You take one step after it.

Your sleeve catches immediately.

The Prowler turns around.

You are being judged.

right.message:
An offering basket hangs inside a thorn cage. After a careful extraction
operation, you recover the Star Candies and only slightly redesign your
clothing.

forward.message:
Restorative sap rests inside a folded leaf beside Shizuki's note:

'Briar balm.

For scratches, snags, and the emotional damage of losing an argument
with a shrub.'
forward.fullHpMessage: You leave the balm untouched. The thicket has not won yet.

briarfin-thickets-depths.prompt:
Living rootways disappear beneath thicker briars. Three passages remain,
although one appears to have grown additional thorns while you watched.

left.message:
Broad silver kelp wraps a cache protected by a suspiciously thorn-free
circle.

Shizuki wrote nearby:

'This means either safe spot or plant trap.

Was safe for me.

Good luck.'

right.message:
A Briarfin Prowler walks straight through a wall of thorns.

You attempt to follow the normal path instead.

It meets you on the other side looking disappointed.

forward.message:
One Berry hangs from a snagged strap from Shizuki's old pack.

Her note reads:

'Forest stole backpack.

Recovered backpack.

Forest kept one buckle.

Acceptable losses.'

briarfin-thickets-threshold.prompt:
Moonlit fronds close around Briar Moon Den. Three final paths wind
through thorn arches shaped like claws.

left.message:
A moonblossom pool sits inside the only thorn-free pocket in sight.
Shizuki wrote:

'Found safe clearing.

Do not celebrate loudly.

Plants may hear.'
left.fullHpMessage: You leave the pool untouched and celebrate internally.

right.message:
A moss-covered shrine coffer lies beneath a briar arch. The vines pull
back slightly when you touch the latch.

Suspiciously polite thorns.

forward.message:
A Briarfin Prowler crouches beyond the final wall of briars.

This time, it waits for YOU to get snagged first.

Experienced hunter.

boss-antechamber.name: Briar Moon Den
boss-antechamber.prompt:
The thorns throughout the Den bend in the same direction as something
moves silently behind them.

bossPromptDiscord:
The Briar Moon Den falls completely still.

Every smaller Prowler disappears into the thickets.

Then the briars part without a single thorn breaking.

Something larger has spent a very long time learning every path through
this forest.

Use /yes to enter the Den or /no to avoid becoming the next thing
caught in the briars.
bossPromptTwitch:
The Briar Moon Den falls completely still.

Every smaller Prowler disappears into the thickets.

Then the briars part without a single thorn breaking.

Something larger has spent a very long time learning every path through
this forest.

Use !yes to enter the Den or !no to avoid becoming the next thing
caught in the briars.
bossRetreatText:
You withdraw through the thickets. The unseen hunter makes no attempt
to follow.

Somehow that is worse.

boss.revealText:
The briars sweep aside as a sleek thorn-armored predator lunges from
the Den.

Thornwake Huntress reveals itself!

completionText:
"The Huntress vanishes into the deepest thicket.

The briars slowly relax.

A thorn immediately catches your sleeve on the way out.

The forest demands the final word."
